blocks.text: Insan ke circulatory system ki bari khoon ki naliyan teen hain: arteries, veins aur capillaries.
1. Arteries

Arteries woh naliyan hain jo khoon ko dil se door, jism ke mukhtalif hisson tak le jati hain. Pulmonary arteries ke siwa tamam arteries oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Artery ke beech ki khali jagah lumen kehlati hai. Artery ki deewar teen tahon (layers) se bani hai. Bahar wali tah tunica externa ya adventitia hai, jo connective aur elastic (lachakdar) tissue se bani hai. Darmiyani tah tunica media hai, jo moti muscular tissue (pathon) aur elastic fibres se bani hai. Andar wali tah tunica intima hai, jo endothelial cells ki patli tah hai. Darmiyani tah sab se ahem hai, kyun ke yeh ventricular systole ke waqt khoon ke zyada dabao (pressure) ko bardasht karti hai. Arteries bat kar chhoti naliyan banati hain jinhen arterioles kehte hain. Arterioles baar baar batti hain aur aakhir mein bohat bareek shakhon ka ghana jaal (network) banati hain; inhen capillaries kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Kati hui artery seedhi-dar belanon (cylinders) ki shakal mein: beech mein lumen, jis par tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah hai; is ke gird smooth muscles aur elastic tissue wala tunica media; aur sab se bahar mota tunica externa, jis se arterioles nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.6: Artery ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.6 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Lumen, Tunica intima (endothelium), Smooth muscles, Elastic tissue, Tunica media, Tunica externa, Arterioles.

blocks.text: 2. Capillaries

Capillaries arterioles ke batne se banti hain, aur capillaries aapas mein mil kar venules banati hain. Capillaries jism ke har tissue mein ghus jati hain aur cells tak pohanchti hain. Capillary ki deewar endothelial cells ki sirf ek tah se bani hoti hai. Capillary ka andar ka qutr (diameter) taqreeban 8 micrometre hota hai. Capillaries hi woh jagah hain jahan khoon aur jism ke tissues ke darmiyan cheezon ka len den (exchange) hota hai; yeh len den diffusion (zyada se kam miqdar ki taraf phailna) ya active transport (energy laga kar le jana) se hota hai. Pani aur diffuse hone wali cheezein capillary ki deewar se guzar sakti hain. Cheezein ya to endothelial cells ke andar se, ya cells ke darmiyan ki khali jagahon (intercellular spaces) se guzarti hain. Kuch cheezon ko capillary ki deewar ke cells endocytosis (cell ka cheez ko nigal lena) se andar lete hain aur phir exocytosis (cell se bahar nikalna) ke zariye doosri taraf chhor dete hain.

blocks.alt: Capillary ek tang tube jis ki deewar chapte endothelial cells ki sirf ek tah hai; khule sire par ek red blood cell lumen ka zyada hissa bhar raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.7: Capillary ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.7 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Jism ka koi bhi cell kisi capillary se 100 micrometre se zyada door nahin. Capillaries itni tang hain ke RBCs un mein se ek qatar (single line) mein guzarte hain. Andaza hai ke ek baligh insan ki tamam capillaries ki kul lambai 80,600 kilometre se zyada hai, jo zameen ke gird do chakkar lagane ke liye kafi hai!

Capillaries ke andar dabao ki wajah se blood plasma ka kuch mayah musalsal bahar tissues mein risata rehta hai. Is mayah ko interstitial fluid kehte hain. Yeh pani hai jis mein ghule hue nutrients, hormones, gases, fuzla (wastes) aur chhote proteins hote hain. Bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillaries ke andar hi rehte hain. Lekin kuch WBCs capillary ki deewar ke cells ke beech ki jagahon se nichur kar (squeeze ho kar) bahar nikal sakte hain.
3. Veins

Veins woh naliyan hain jo khoon ko jism ke mukhtalif hisson se dil ki taraf le jati hain. Pulmonary veins ke siwa tamam veins deoxygenated khoon le jati hain. Vein ki deewar mein bhi artery wali teen tahein hoti hain. Bahar wali tah tunica externa (adventitia) connective aur elastic tissue se bani hai. Darmiyani tah tunica media nisbatan (comparatively) patli hai, is mein muscles thore aur elastic fibres kam hote hain. Andar wali tah tunica intima endothelial cells ki patli tah hai.

Vein ki darmiyani tah artery ke muqable mein patli hoti hai, kyun ke veins ko zyada dabao bardasht nahin karna parta. Khali artery phir bhi khokhli nali ki shakal mein rehti hai, lekin khali vein khali ghubbare ki tarah pichak jati hai. Veins mein semilunar valves hote hain jo dil ki taraf jate hue khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain. Aas paas ke muscles jab sukarte hain to veins ko dabate hain, aur is dabao se khoon ko dil ki taraf wapas jane mein madad milti hai.

blocks.alt: Kati hui vein seedhi-dar belanon ki shakal mein: chaura lumen jis ke andar valve hai, tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah; smooth muscles ka patla tunica media; aur bahari tunica externa, jis mein pehlu se venule milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.8: Vein ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 11.8 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Valve, Tunica intima (endothelium), Lumen, Smooth muscles, Tunica media, Tunica externa, Venule.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Artery (Figure 11.6) se muqabla karein: vein ka tunica media patla aur lumen chaura hai, aur us mein valve hai jo khoon ko wapas behne nahin deta.

Chhoti veins mil kar bari veins banati hain aur aakhir mein vena cavae (inferior vena cava aur superior vena cava) banti hain, jo khoon ko dil ke daen atrium mein daalti hain. Phephron se aane wali pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf surkh artery se arterioles nikalti hain; har capillary loop ke shuru mein precapillary sphincter hai. Jamni capillaries arterioles ko venules se jorti hain, jo daen taraf neeli vein mein khulti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.9: Arterioles, capillaries aur venules ka talluq (textbook ki Figure 11.9 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Artery, Arteriole, Precapillary sphincters, Capillaries, Venule, Vein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khoon ka rasta: artery -> arteriole -> capillaries -> venule -> vein. Rang surkh (oxygenated) se neela (deoxygenated) hota jata hai kyunke capillaries mein oxygen tissues ko di jati hai.
Capillaries mein khoon ke bahao ka control (Regulation of Blood Flow in Capillaries)

Capillaries mein kitna khoon jaye, yeh capillaries ko tang (constrict) ya chaura (dilate) kar ke control hota hai. Nerves ka signal (nervous stimulation) capillaries ko tang kar sakta hai, aur kuch chemicals, maslan histamine, unhen chaura kar sakte hain. Kuch capillaries doosri capillaries ke loops (chhallon) ke zariye arterioles aur venules se juri hoti hain. Har loop ke shuru mein muscle ka ek chhalla hota hai jise pre-capillary sphincter kehte hain. Yeh sphincters control karte hain ke capillaries mein kitna khoon jaye.

blocks.alt: Oopar arteriole aur neeche venule, chhe capillary loops se jure jo arteriole ke qareeb surkh aur venule ke qareeb neele hain. Har loop ke arteriole se nikalne ki jagah challa (ring) numa pre-capillary sphincter hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.10: Pre-capillary sphincters (textbook ki Figure 11.10 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Arteriole, Pre-capillary sphincter, Capillaries, Venule.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sphincter sukre to us loop mein khoon kam jata hai, dheela ho to zyada. Is tarah jism zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon bheejta hai.
Arterioles mein vasoconstriction aur vasodilation

Arterioles ki deewaron mein elastic tissue ke muqable mein gol (circular) muscles zyada hote hain. In circular muscles ka sukarna nervous system aur endocrine system (hormones wala nizam) ke control mein hai. Jab yeh muscles sukarte hain to arterioles tang ho jati hain. Isay vasoconstriction kehte hain; is se arterioles mein khoon ka bahao kam ho jata hai. Jab yeh muscles dheele hote hain to arterioles chauri ho jati hain. Isay vasodilation kehte hain; is se un mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai.

Vasoconstriction aur vasodilation tissues ki metabolic activity (cells ke kaam ki raftar) badalne par hoti hain. Maslan jab kisi tissue ki metabolic activity barhti hai to us ke interstitial fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada ho jati hai. Is ke jawab mein us tissue ki arterioles ke circular muscles dheele ho jate hain (vasodilation). Is se in arterioles aur capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai. Zyada khoon zyada oxygen lata hai aur zyada carbon dioxide le jata hai. Isi tarah metabolic activity kam ho to arterioles mein vasoconstriction hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Faal (active) tissue cells ki qatar ke neeche do arterioles. Baen: tang arteriole jis se capillaries mein normal blood flow hai; oopar tissue fluid mein oxygen zyada hai. Daen: tissue fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hai, aur chauri phaili (dilated) arteriole capillaries mein zyada khoon le jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.11: Vasodilation (textbook ki Figure 11.11 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Active tissue, Less oxygen, More carbon dioxide, Normal blood flow, Capillaries, Increased blood flow, dilated arteriole.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tissue zyada kaam kare to O2 kam aur CO2 zyada hoti hai; is ke jawab mein arteriole ke circular muscles dheele hote hain (vasodilation) aur zyada khoon aa kar zyada O2 deta hai.
Khoon ke bahao ki raftar (Rate of Blood Flow)

Mukhtalif naliyon mein khoon ki raftar (velocity) mukhtalif hoti hai. Yeh aorta mein sab se zyada hoti hai (450-500 mm fi second), phir arteries aur arterioles mein kam hoti jati hai aur capillaries mein sab se kam hoti hai (taqreeban 1 mm fi second; kitab mein “01 mm/sec” chhapa hai). Venules, veins aur vena cavae mein raftar phir barh jati hai (250-300 mm fi second). Raftar ki yeh tabdeeli naliyon ke kul cross section (tamam naliyon ke kate hue hisse ka mila kar raqba) badalne ki wajah se hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph jis ke y-axis par khoon ki raftar (mm/sec) 0 se 500 tak aur x-axis par aorta, arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, veins aur vena cava ki rangeen pattiyan hain. Peeli lakeer aorta mein qareeb 480 se shuru ho kar arteries aur arterioles mein girti hai, capillaries mein taqreeban sifar ho jati hai, phir venules aur veins mein barh kar vena cava mein qareeb 270 tak aati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.12: Mukhtalif naliyon mein khoon ki raftar (textbook ki Figure 11.12 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Capillaries ka majmui cross-section sab se zyada hai, is liye wahan khoon sab se aahista chalta hai aur tabadle ke liye waqt milta hai. Textbook ka '01 mm/sec' asal mein taqreeban 1 mm/sec hai.
Khoon ke daure ke raste (Circulatory Pathways)

Insanon mein (aur tamam mammals aur parindon mein) khoon jism mein do bare raston se daura karta hai. Inhen pulmonary circulation (phephron tak jana aur wahan se wapas aana) aur systemic circulation (jism ke baqi hisson tak jana aur wapas aana) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Beech mein dil. Pulmonary circulation: pulmonary arteries (neeli) khoon ko daen aur baen phephron ke capillary beds tak le jati hain aur right aur left pulmonary veins (surkh) wapas lati hain. Systemic circulation: aorta (surkh) khoon ko oopar baazuon aur sar, aur neeche andaruni aza aur tangon tak le jati hai; superior aur inferior vena cava (neeli) wapas late hain. Teer rukh aur brackets dono circulations dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: pulmonary arteries mein deoxygenated aur pulmonary veins mein oxygenated khoon hota hai, systemic naliyon ka ulta.
Pulmonary circulation

Pulmonary circulation phephron ko deoxygenated khoon deti hai aur oxygenated khoon wapas dil ko lati hai. Ek bari artery, pulmonary trunk, dil ke daen ventricle se deoxygenated khoon le jati hai. Pulmonary trunk daen aur baen pulmonary arteries mein bat jata hai, jo deoxygenated khoon daen aur baen phephre tak le jati hain. Har phephre ke andar pulmonary artery bat kar pulmonary arterioles aur phephron ki capillaries banati hai. Phephron ki capillaries mein khoon oxygenated hota hai (oxygen leta hai). Phephron ki capillaries mil kar pulmonary venules banati hain, aur yeh mil kar pulmonary vein banati hain. Phephron se baen aur daen pulmonary veins baen atrium mein khulti hain.
Systemic circulation
Systemic circulation phephron ke siwa jism ke tamam cells, tissues aur aza ko oxygenated khoon deti hai aur deoxygenated khoon wapas dil ko lati hai. Is ke yeh hisse hain:
1. Coronary circulation

Dil ki apni deewaron ko khoon systemic circulation ke ek chhote hisse se milta hai. Do coronary arteries, daen aur baen coronary artery, aorta ke shuru ke qareeb se nikalti hain. Yeh arteries bat kar bohat si chhoti arteries, phir arterioles aur phir capillaries banati hain. Dil ke muscles ko oxygenated khoon dene ke baad capillaries mil kar venules banati hain, jo bohat si coronary veins banati hain. Coronary veins mil kar coronary sinus banati hain, jo daen atrium mein khulta hai. Chhoti coronary veins seedhi daen atrium mein khul jati hain.

blocks.alt: Dil ke do manzar, oopar vena cava aur aorta. Saamne ka manzar (anterior): left aur right coronary arteries aorta ki jarr se nikal kar dil ki deewar par shakhein banati hain, saath coronary veins. Peeche ka manzar (posterior): coronary veins oopar ja kar bari coronary sinus mein milti hain jo dil ki pusht par se guzarti hai, aur saath right coronary artery hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.14: Coronary circulation (textbook ki Figure 11.14 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Left coronary artery, Right coronary artery, Coronary veins, Coronary sinus, Right coronary artery, (Anterior view), (Posterior view).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Coronary sinus right atrium mein khulti hai. Dil ki apni deewar ko khoon in coronary arteries se milta hai, chambers ke khoon se nahin.
2. Hepatic portal circulation

Portal system aisa daura hai jis mein veins (dil tak jane ke bajaye) capillaries par khatam hoti hain. Hepatic portal system mein ek bari hepatic portal vein tilli (spleen) aur alimentary canal (khaane ki nali aur aanton) se khoon ikattha kar ke jigar (liver) tak le jati hai. Jigar se khoon hepatic veins ke zariye dil tak jata hai.

Alimentary canal se jigar tak aane wale khoon mein woh cheezein hoti hain jo chhoti aant (small intestine) ne jazb ki hoti hain. Yeh cheezein dil tak jane se pehle jigar se guzarti hain. Jigar khoon se nuqsan-deh (harmful) cheezein nikal deta hai aur nutrients ko zakhira (storage) karne ke liye le leta hai, phir yeh khoon dil ko bhejta hai. Hepatic portal system oesophagus (khaane ki nali) ke nichle hisse se le kar anal canal ke oopri hisse tak phaila hua hai.

blocks.alt: Jigar (liver) aur us ke saath maida, tilli (spleen) aur pancreas, aur neeche colon chhoti aant ko ghere hue. Chhoti aant, colon, pancreas aur spleen ki veins mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain, jo jigar mein ja kar shakhein banati hai. Hepatic veins jigar se khoon inferior vena cava mein le jati hain, jo beech mein oopar jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.15: Hepatic portal system (textbook ki Figure 11.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Inferior vena cava, Hepatic veins, Spleen, Pancreas, Hepatic portal vein, Ascending colon, Descending colon, Small intestine.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Portal system mein vein capillaries se shuru ho kar doosri capillaries (jigar mein) par khatm hoti hai. Is liye aant se jazb hone wali cheezein pehle jigar se guzarti hain.
3. Renal circulation

Yeh bhi systemic circulation ka ek ahem hissa hai. Daen aur baen renal arteries daen aur baen gurde (kidney) tak oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Gurde ke andar har renal artery baar baar bat kar chhoti arteries banati hai. Chhoti arteries bat kar kai afferent arterioles banati hain, jo nephrons (gurde ki kaam karne wali ikaiyan) ko khoon deti hain. Har afferent arteriole bat kar glomerulus ki capillaries banati hai.

Glomerulus ki capillaries mil kar efferent arteriole banati hain. Efferent arteriole phir bat kar capillaries ke do set banati hai: (i) peri-tubular capillaries (gurde ke cortex wale hisse mein nephron ki nali ke gird), aur (ii) vasa recta (gurde ke medulla mein nephron ki nali ke gird). Yeh capillaries mil kar venules banati hain, venules mil kar chhoti veins, aur chhoti veins mil kar renal vein banati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron aur us ki khoon ki faraahmi. Chhoti artery afferent arteriole deti hai jo glomerulus banati hai; efferent arteriole us se nikal kar lipti tubule ke gird peri-tubular capillaries aur loop ke saath vasa recta banati hai; venule chhoti vein mein khulti hai. Daen: gurde ki qash jis mein renal artery se chhoti arteries phailti hain aur renal vein bahar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.16: Renal circulation (textbook ki Figure 11.16 ke mutabiq asal drawing; kitab mein caption 'Renal portal system' chhapi hai).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Peri-tubular capillaries, Efferent arteriole, Glomerulus, Afferent arteriole, Smaller arteries, Vasa recta, Venule, Smaller vein, Renal vein, Renal artery.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Textbook is figure ki caption 'Renal portal system' chhapti hai, magar insaan mein renal portal system nahin hota (yeh machhli aur amphibians mein hota hai); kitab ka apna heading 'Renal Circulation' hai. Yahan afferent arteriole -> glomerulus -> efferent arteriole -> peri-tubular capillaries/vasa recta -> venule -> renal vein ka raasta hai, is liye caption 'Renal circulation' likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Portal system ghair-mamooli kyun hai, aur hepatic portal system jism ko kya faida deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar circuits mein vein khoon seedha dil ko lautati hai, magar portal system mein vein capillaries ke doosre bed par khatm hoti hai. Hepatic portal vein tilli aur alimentary canal ka khoon, jo chhoti aant mein abhi jazb shuda maddon se bhara hai, pehle jigar ki capillaries mein le jati hai, taake jigar nuqsan-deh maddey hata aur nutrients zakheera kar sake, phir hepatic veins khoon dil aur baqi jism tak bhejti hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Artery: dil se door khoon; teen tahein, moti muscular tunica media jo zyada dabao sehti hai. Capillary: endothelial cells ki ek tah, taqreeban 8 micrometre; yahin len den hota hai aur interstitial fluid bahar risata hai. Vein: dil ki taraf khoon; patli tunica media, semilunar valves, khali ho kar pichak jati hai.

Capillaries mein bahao: nerves tang karti hain, histamine chaura karti hai, pre-capillary sphincters loops ko kholte band karte hain. Arterioles: muscles sukrein to vasoconstriction (kam khoon), dheele hon to vasodilation (zyada khoon).
Raftar: aorta 450-500 mm/s, capillaries sab se kam (taqreeban 1 mm/s), vena cavae 250-300 mm/s.

Pulmonary circulation: daan ventricle → pulmonary trunk → phephre → pulmonary veins → baan atrium. Systemic circulation ke hisse: coronary (aorta → dil ki deewar → coronary sinus → daan atrium), hepatic portal (aanten aur tilli → hepatic portal vein → jigar → hepatic veins), renal (renal artery → afferent arteriole → glomerulus → efferent arteriole → peri-tubular capillaries aur vasa recta → renal vein).
